headline: Lane Forecast: see the next swarm before it lands
summary: May 3 ships Lane Forecast — an in-canvas telegraph that draws each scripted enemy spawn directly on the lane it will arrive in, before it arrives. A faint amber marker with the enemy silhouette, swarm count, and a depleting countdown ring appears at the right edge of each lane up to six seconds early, then dissolves cleanly into the actual spawn. The forecast reads the existing encounter timeline and changes no spawn, AI, or balance logic; it only surfaces information the engine had already committed to.

winner.title: Lane Forecast — Live Threat Telegraphs
winner.summary: An in-canvas per-lane marker that previews each scripted spawn (enemy, swarm count, countdown ring) up to six seconds before it arrives, then dissolves into the actual spawn.

rationale: Lane Forecast won because it is the smallest credible 'make Rootline Defense more legible without making it easier by stat tuning' cycle. It surfaces information the encounter system has already committed to — a per-lane silhouette, swarm count, and depleting countdown ring at the right edge of the playable board, six seconds before the spawn — and it dissolves cleanly into the actual enemy when the moment arrives. No spawn, AI, or balance logic changed. Hard boards stay hard because tactical choice (Pod the armor, splash the swarm) remains the load-bearing decision; the forecast only tells visitors when and where the next threat lands.
